content:
Sam: Kicking off prod deploy for release v2.14.0 — change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary -> 10% to start. Ping @Alyssa (oncall) for SLO watch.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: id=dep_2026_02_14_78, canary=10% -> https://dashboard.redwood/internal/deploys/dep_2026_02_14_78 :rocket:

Jia: Which dashboards should we monitor specifically? p99 on inference or error spikes?

Sam: Watch inference-slo (p50/p95/p99), request-error-rate, and per-model throughput. Also keep an eye on the KV cache miss rate. Links: https://dash/redwood/inference-slo, https://dash/redwood/errs 

alerts-bot: SLO smoke check completed pre-deploy: synthetic latency 48ms (ok), baseline error rate 0.2% (ok).

Maria: Canary started looks good at first 2 minutes, no regressions in token throughput.

ops-bot: Synthetic probe /v1/generate (eu-west) latency=60ms, status=200, 10 reqs/min.

(deploy in progress)

alerts-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in eu-west - last 1m error_rate=3.8% (baseline 0.25%) - triggered at 1768012389.

Jia: seeing the same in the SLO board — p95 latency spiked to ~1.2s for canary traffic, errors concentrated on model shard a3.

Maria: snippet from the canary logs: ```
2026-02-14T02:06:28Z [err] model a3: kvcache miss, fallback decode timeout
2026-02-14T02:06:29Z [err] downstream fetch failed: context deadline exceeded
```

Kevin: Any recent kernel/quantization knobs changed in this release that touch model a3? We changed the fused-attn version in runtime config.

Sam: Yes, v2.14 switched fused-attn 1.9 -> 2.0 for perf. It was tested locally but not on this hardware configuration.

Alyssa (oncall): Recommend pausing rollout and pin traffic back to previous model variant for safety. We should avoid full rollback unless pause doesn't stabilize.

Sam: Agree. Deploy-bot, pause the rollout to canary.

deploy-bot: Command received: `pause rollout dep_2026_02_14_78` -> rollout paused at 10% canary.

Jia: I'm going to re-route canary traffic for shard a3 to model variant rwl-model-1.3.2 (pinned) for testing. If that clears errors we can iterate on runtime flag.

Kevin: Suggest also toggling `runtime.fused_attn=1.9` as a quick ab test on canary only. Can you patch and repro?

Maria: On it — applying canary patch now. Running quick smoke: `curl -X POST https://canary.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'`

ops-bot: Canary smoke results: 20 requests, success=20, p95=72ms, errors=0.

Jia: With shard a3 pinned to rwl-model-1.3.2 errors dropped to 0.4% (from 3.8%). Looks like the model runtime change is the likely culprit.

Sam: Good. Hold rollout paused. We'll create a short rollback plan: (1) pin all traffic for v2.14 endpoints to rwl-model-1.3.2, (2) revert fused-attn to 1.9 in the runtime branch, (3) run extended canary tomorrow with expanded infra matrix.

Kevin: I can prepare the runtime revert PR now. ETA ~25m.

Alyssa (oncall): I'll update the change calendar + notify oncall rotation. Also marking alert as P1 mitigated for now.

deploy-bot: Rollout status: paused at canary=10%. No new canary traffic being promoted.

alerts-bot: Alert resolved (error rate back to baseline) at 1768012462.

Sam: Thanks everyone. For the release notes we should add: "Hold v2.14.0 rollout due to fused-attn runtime regression; model variant pin applied; follow-up runtime revert planned."

Maria: Filing a short postmortem draft and linking PRs.

Jia: For tracking: incident ticket INC-2026-022 created -> https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-022

Sam: Closing thread for now. We'll reconvene when the runtime PR is up and we've validated extended canary. :thumbsup:

(deploy-bot): Deployment paused by Sam at 1768012410.

ops-bot: Monitoring snapshot after pause: p95=85ms, error_rate=0.18% (5m avg). All green.
